2122072397121560616.en_summary: The national debt is growing at an unprecedented pace, and almost no one in Washington is prepared to stop it, per the WSJ. Debt held by the public is now larger than the entire US economy for the first time since World War II, and interest payments alone top $1 trillion a year. The CBO projects debt will reach 120% of GDP by 2036, well above the postwar record.
